title: Exposure of sensitive system information to an unauthorized control sphere vulnerability in Tegsoft… (CVE-2026-14915)
description: CVE-2026-14915 is a vulnerability in Tegsoft İletişim Merkezi that allows unauthorized exposure of sensitive system information via a query system. It affects versions before latest-202611161510. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating that it can be exploited remotely without privileges or user interaction to disclose information.
